description: RNG pairing architecture, seed-branching guarantees, and Common Random Numbers (CRN) protocol for paired counterfactual partner-force autonomy experiment.

cloning_protocol.state_cloning: Exact deep clone of ParticleWorld at time T via checkpoint deserialization or in-memory clone.
cloning_protocol.rng_state_preservation: Cloned world inherits identical deterministic PRNG state (particle.rng) at time T.
immediate_diff_allowlist: particle.config.partner_support.enabled (switched to false on OFF branch)
particle.partner_support.withdrawal_time (set to Some(T) on OFF branch)
particle.partner_support.window_snapshots (records withdrawal event snapshot on OFF branch)
cloning_protocol.bit_for_bit_invariant: All indigenous state arrays (formations, people, organizations, leaders, social_edges, command_edges, manpower, political, foreign, relations, logistics, security_posts, footholds, locality, zones, counters, rng) are bit-for-bit identical immediately after withdrawal call.

common_random_numbers_guarantees.policy: Common Random Numbers (CRN) are enforced across paired ON and OFF trajectories starting from W_T.
common_random_numbers_guarantees.variance_reduction: Pairwise differencing Delta_h = C_ON(T+h) - C_OFF(T+h) and ratio R_h = C_OFF(T+h) / max(C_ON(T+h), epsilon) removes exogenous environmental and stochastic noise common to both branches.
common_random_numbers_guarantees.stochastic_coupling: Both branches experience identical weather, insurgent strategic draws, and locality background shocks unless endogenous divergence alters subsequent event schedules.
common_random_numbers_guarantees.substream_isolation: External assistance channels (air support sorties, logistics deliveries, movement advisory boosts, force gen pipeline increments) consume zero exogenous PRNG draws or use deterministic bounded allocations to preserve cross-branch synchronization as long as contact states remain matched.

verification_tests.property: Cloning at step 5 produces identical trajectories if both branches maintain support; OFF branch diverges deterministically only through external channel removal.
Verifies that immediately upon calling withdraw_external_partner_support(), zero indigenous fields, formations, edges, or counters are mutated.
